hypothesis: A supervised soft pitch gate and pitch-specific control experts trained end to end on final control Brier can retain the large legal pitch-conditional oracle signal better than separately optimized pitch classification or independent experts.

novelty_vs_prior.separate_pitch_moe: Previously optimized selector log-loss and expert outcomes separately.
novelty_vs_prior.dense_multitask: Previously shared auxiliary heads but primary prediction ignored their pitch probabilities.
novelty_vs_prior.this_recipe: Final prediction is the differentiable product-sum of a three-way gate and three control experts; final BCE+Brier, gate CE, and true-group expert BCE are trained jointly.

data_contract.history_rows: R rows with season strictly before validation year
data_contract.pitch_group_label: next same-pitcher official pitchmix-counter increment inside completed history only

candidate.route: blend candidate on R only; exact-C unchanged on F

source_protocol.selection_rule: highest 2020 R gain, then full gain, then smallest gamma
source_protocol.if_source_passes: freeze recipe and evaluate fresh 2022/2023 development before 2024
